caption: Two hands struggle to twist the lid off a tight jar and finally get it open, lid in hand.

sa.check: Two hands grip a jar and its lid.
The lid ends up in a hand.
The effort is visible before the lid gives.
The twist comes first and the lid comes off after.

pc.expect: The lid turns and comes off only after the twist, not before.
pc.fail: The lid comes off before any twist; or the hands twist with the lid fixed for the whole clip and then it is in hand; or the lid lifts off with no turn.

pc.expect: The hands grip, the forearms twist in opposite directions, and the fingers stay attached.
pc.fail: Fingers pass through the lid; or a hand detaches; or the hands merge with the jar.

pc.expect: The jar stays still in one hand and the lid moves only with the other.
pc.fail: The lid spins on its own; or the jar turns while the hands are still; or the lid floats off.

pc.expect: The jar and the lid stay rigid.
pc.fail: The jar bends; or the lid stretches; or the jar shatters from the twist.

pc.expect: One jar and one lid keep their number.
pc.fail: The lid duplicates; or the jar vanishes; or the lid turns into another object.

pc.expect: The jar's label and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The label changes; or the hands change; or the background rearranges.

note: The hands are the physics here: grip and twist. The person behind them is not judged.
